I replied to Hollis in a thread under his message in #central-team. The only deadline anyone has given is **25 August**, which Pree posted there on 14 October, but I told him it isn't confirmed yet.

- **Possible error:** 25 August had already passed when Pree posted it. I asked her whether she meant next year or whether the form is overdue, and she hasn't replied in that channel.
- **Nothing to check against:** I couldn't find any Tansley Parcel files on the share. The incident channel and the earlier #central-team messages don't mention the deadline either. Both are channels Hollis can see.

I suggested he confirm with Pree before putting the date in the account sheet. A signing deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share with him as a member of the account's team.
